purpose: Teach: ひっくり返し/潰す/すこぶる/おち/のぼっ/戴き/なけりゃ/ばらつき

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コーヒーカップをひっくり返してしまわれたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer knocked over their coffee cup.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact delivery. Light wry humor in the cadence. The tone of someone who's seen this before and finds it mildly amusing rather than troubling.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、忙しさで体を潰す事のないように気を付けようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, just be careful not to work yourself to exhaustion, all right?
lines.style: Warm concern underneath. Soft, maternal pacing. A gentle reminder disguised as practical advice. Slight emphasis on 'yourself' — protective but not fussy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、すこぶる好評ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the new menu is doing really well.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Warm approval. Slow enough to land the compliment. A small smile in the voice — the kind of pleasure that comes from seeing something you care about succeed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、おちのある面白いお話を聞かせて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer told us the funniest story with the best punchline.
lines.style: Brightness in the opening. Genuine delight — the kind that spreads easily. Light pace, almost conversational. Sharing something that made the day better.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、二階にのぼってお席に着かれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer went upstairs and got settled in their seat.
lines.style: Observant, neutral tone. Quiet noticing rather than reporting. Slight wondering quality — the tone of someone watching a small moment pass by. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様から手作りジャムを戴きました、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer brought us homemade jam.
lines.style: Warmth and genuine appreciation. Slight lift at the opening — genuine pleasure at kindness received. Soft completion, like savoring the thoughtfulness of it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様がいなけりゃ、お店も成り立たないね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, without customers there wouldn't be a shop at all.
lines.style: Thoughtful, grounded observation. Even pace. A moment of quiet clarity — not profound, just true. The tone of someone who has thought about this before.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の好みにもばらつきがあるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, our customers all have different tastes, don't they?
lines.style: Gentle observation trailing into a question. Reflective, almost musing. Soft pace, slight rise at the end. The quiet acceptance of variety as a small truth.
